buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Tender Inviting Authority This tender is issued by the Director, ICMR-National Institute of Translational Virology and AIDS Research ( NITVAR), Pune, Maharashtra, for procurement of the Consumables as specified in the GeM Bid document, S pecification document attached and clarified as per clause 23 of this Buyer Added Terms and Conditions , a s per the technical specifications detailed in the Specification Document attached under the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC. 2. Bid Security Declaration In accordance with Rule 170 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, the Bid Security Declaration shall be applicable. MSEs registered under the applicable MSME Procurement Policy and DPIIT-recognized Startups shall be ex empt from submission of EMD, subject to fulfillment of the applicable eligibility conditions and submission of valid supporting documents, wherever applicable. 3. Eligibility Criteria The bidder shall be either: a. The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM)/Original Manufacturer of the offered reagents; or b. An authorized distributor/dealer/agent of the OEM/Original Manufacturer. Where the bidder is not the OE

M/Original Manufacturer, a valid authorization certificate issued by the OEM/Original Manufacturer shall be submitted along with the bid, wherever applicable. 4. One Bid per Bidder Each bidder shall submit only one bid against this tender. Submission of multiple bids by the same bidder, either directly or indirectly, may result in disqualification in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and conditions. 5. Right to Accept, Reject or Cancel the Tender The Director, ICMR-NITVAR reserves the right to accept or reject any bid and/or cancel the tender, in whole or in part, at any stage, in accordance with applicable Government rules, procurement guidelines and GeM terms and conditions. 6. Inspection and Testing ICMR-NITVAR or its designated representative reserves the right to inspect and/or test the supplied reagen ts, wherever considered necessary, to verify conformity with the prescribed specifications, quality require ments, quantity, batch/lot details, shelf life and other contractual requirements. The supplier shall provide all necessary assistance and relevant documentation required for such inspectio n and/or testing. 7. Acceptance of Supplies The supplied reagents shall be subject to inspection and verification upon receipt at ICMR-NITVAR. Acceptance shall be accorded only after verification of the quantity, specifications, quality, packaging, bat ch/lot details, expiry date/residual shelf life and other prescribed requirements. Any material found to be damaged, defective, expired, short-supplied, incorrectly supplied or otherwise no t conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be liable for rejection and replacement by the supplier a t no additional cost to ICMR-NITVAR. 8. Packing and Transportation The Reagents shall be suitably packed to protect them from damage, contamination, deterioration, moistu re, temperature variation and other risks during handling, transportation and storage. The supplier shall ensure that the packaging complies with applicable statutory, regulatory and manufactu rer requirements. The material shall be delivered to the consignee location specified in the GeM Contract. Where the nature of the reagents requires specific transportation or storage conditions, the supplier shall e nsure compliance with such conditions throughout transportation and delivery. 9. Replacement of Defective/Damaged Material Any Reagent found to be defective, damaged, contaminated, deteriorated, expired, short-supplied or other wise not conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost to ICMR-NITVAR. The replacement shall be made within the period specified by ICMR-NITVAR. 10. Payment Terms 100% payment shall be released after successful delivery, inspection and acceptance of the reagents by I CMR-NITVAR and submission of all required documents, subject to applicable statutory deductions. The following documents shall be submitted for processing of payment, as applicable: a. Copy of Purchase Order/GeM Contract; b. Tax Invoice; c. Delivery Challan/Consignee Receipt;

d. Inspection/Acceptance Certificate, wherever applicable; and e. Any other document required under the GeM Bid/Contract. 11. Liquidated Damages In the event of delay in delivery attributable to the supplier, Liquidated Damages shall be levied in accord ance with the provisions of the applicable GeM Contract, subject to the maximum permissible limit prescrib ed therein. 12. GST and Other Taxes GST and all other applicable taxes, duties, levies and statutory charges shall be governed by the prevailing Government of India rules and regulations. Unless specifically provided otherwise in the GeM Bid, the rates quoted by the bidder shall be inclusive of all applicable charges up to the consignee location. 13. Blacklisted/Debarred Firms Bidders who, as on the date of bid submission, are blacklisted, debarred, suspended or otherwise prohibite d from participating in procurement by any Government Organization or by the GeM Portal shall be ineligi ble to participate in this GeM Bid. The bidder shall comply with all applicable declarations and requirements prescribed under the GeM terms and conditions in this regard. 14. Delivery The complete quantity of the consumables shall be delivered at the following consignee location: ICMR-National Institute of Translational Virology and AIDS Research (NITVAR), Pune, Maharash tra. The complete supply shall be delivered within the delivery period specified in the GeM Contract. 15. Technical Compliance and Documents The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the bid: a. Point-wise compliance against each specification mentioned in the attached Specification Document; b. Product catalogue/brochure/data sheet, wherever applicable; c. OEM/Manufacturer Authorization Certificate, wherever applicable; d. Details of make, model, product code/catalogue number, wherever applicable; and e. Any other supporting technical literature or document specifically required under the bid. Failure to submit the required technical documents may result in the bid being considered non-responsive, subject to applicable GeM provisions. 16. Discrepancy Between GeM Bid and Specification Document In the event of any discrepancy, inconsistency or conflict between the specifications mentioned in the GeM Bid and those specified in the Specification Document attached under the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC, t he provisions of the Specification Document shall prevail, to the extent permissible under applicable GeM t erms and Government rules. 17. Contract Splitting Contract splitting shall not be applicable for this tender. The complete quantity shall be considered as one procurement requirement and shall be supplied in accordance with the GeM Contract, subject to applicabl e GeM provisions. 18. Dispute Resolution Any dispute arising out of or in connection with the contract shall, in the first instance, be resolved amicabl y through mutual consultation between the parties.

In the event that the dispute cannot be resolved amicably, the same shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable contractual provisions, GeM terms and conditions and applicable laws of India. The jurisdiction for arbitration and/or legal proceedings, to the extent permissible under the applicable con tractual provisions, shall be Pune, Maharashtra. 19. Precedence of Buyer Added ATC Conditions In the event of any discrepancy or inconsistency between the standard GeM Bid Terms and Conditions and the conditions specified in this Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC, the provisions of this Buyer Added Bid Specif ic ATC shall prevail to the extent permissible under the applicable GeM terms and conditions and Governm ent rules. 20. Compliance with Statutory and Regulatory Requirements The bidder/supplier shall comply with all applicable statutory, regulatory and legal requirements relating to the manufacture, supply, packaging, transportation, storage and delivery of the consumables. Where applicable, the supplier shall ensure that the supplied consumables are accompanied by the requisi te certificates, licences, batch/lot details, test certificates, product literature or other documents prescribe d under applicable laws, regulations or the Specification Document. 21. General Conditions Any matter not specifically covered under this Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC shall be governed by the appl icable GeM General Terms and Conditions, bid-specific terms and conditions, General Financial Rules (GFR) , 2017, Government of India procurement policies and other applicable statutory provisions, as amended fr om time to time. . 2. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors.

vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller.
